The main takeaway from our work is that
LC-TOF/MS can be used for the identification of active ingredients in herbal supplements, with the advantage of not needing a prior knowledge on their structure.

the use of a high resolution MS technique coupled with a high sensitivity triple quadrupole MS/MS instrument is an effective and rapid approach to unequivocably identify and quantify active pharmaceutical ingredients in herbal supplements.
